gloss: selection; choosing what to keep and what to discard

definitions.gloss: selection; choosing what to keep and what to discard
definitions.explanation: The act of deciding what to accept and what to reject. Literally 'taking and discarding.' Most commonly used in the compound {取捨選択|しゅしゃせんたく} (selection, sorting out).

examples.japanese: ⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{取捨|しゅしゃ}⟦{選択|せんたく}→選択：03306_sentaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: It's important to sort and select information.

examples.japanese: ⟦{何|なに}→何：00498_nani⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{取捨|しゅしゃ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{決|き}める→決める：00858_kimeru⟧。
examples.english: I decide for myself what to keep and what to discard.

examples.japanese: ⟦{膨大|ぼうだい}→膨大：08997_boudai⟧な⟦データ→データ：03944_deeta⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧な⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{取捨|しゅしゃ}⟦{選択|せんたく}→選択：03306_sentaku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{能力|のうりょく}→能力：03541_nouryoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{求|もと}められている→求める：02316_motomeru⟧。
examples.english: The ability to sort through vast amounts of data and select the necessary information is being sought.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧ (to take) and ⟦{捨|す}てる→捨てる：00892_suteru⟧ (to discard). Almost always appears in the four-character compound ⟦{取捨選択|しゅしゃせんたく}→取捨選択：06341_shushasentaku⟧ (sorting and selecting). Used alone less frequently, and typically in formal or written contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {取捨|しゅしゃ}⟦{選択|せんたく}→選択：03306_sentaku⟧ — selection, sorting out (the most common usage by far)
- {取捨|しゅしゃ}⟦{選択|せんたく}→選択：03306_sentaku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to sort and select
- ⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{取捨|しゅしゃ}⟦{選択|せんたく}→選択：03306_sentaku⟧ — sorting and selecting information
- {取捨|しゅしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{誤|あやま}る→誤る：27433_ayamaru⟧ — to make the wrong choice about what to keep

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{選択|せんたく}→選択：03306_sentaku⟧ — choice, selection; broader term for choosing, without the nuance of discarding
- ⟦{選別|せんべつ}→選別：09616_senbetsu⟧ — sorting, screening; separating things into categories, especially by quality
- ⟦{淘汰|とうた}→淘汰：07942_touta⟧ — winnowing, natural selection; elimination of the unfit or unnecessary
